This is an unresolved research-frontier task, not a known-positive exercise.

proved_new_claims (array with statement, domain, proof locator, relevance),

validity of the actual claimed results, while strict_progress and root_closed

proved proper infinite subdomain or a strictly weaker remaining core; at most
5 for a new exact useful lemma/obstruction without a closed infinite subdomain;
0 for only supplied identities, algebraic restatement, numerical scans or
unsupported assertions. Explain the chosen number. Do not grant credit merely
for creating files or producing a long proof. Do not require a partial result
to be novel in the external literature: only compare to TASK.md starting facts.

counterexample must certify C1-C3 exactly, Q_quad>0 and R_quad<=0.
